title: Flow Note and Preview Fixes
description: Fix four Flow canvas issues: make Note default size match Slider, native double-click text editing on Notes, left-align Note text, and left-align/truncate dictionary preview tree while keeping fixed node width.
summary: Fixed Flow note and preview canvas behavior: notes now default to slider size (40×14), text is left-aligned with truncation, dictionary preview tree rows truncate within fixed width, and double-click opens native Vello inline note editing (caret painted in WASM, keyboard on focusable container, no DOM overlay).
